With over 400 full-time journalists, 750 freelancers, and 19 local bureaus, RFE/RL is one of the most comprehensive news operations in the world. RFE/RL operates in countries where a free press is banned by the government or not fully established. We provide what many people cannot get locally: uncensored news, responsible discussion and open debate.  

Get the latest, breaking news from RFE/RL and our global network of journalists. 

Highlights: 
• News in 22 languages
• Covering 36 regions and countries 
• Customize your news by topic 
• Enjoy reading, listening and watching
• Live broadcasts include audio, video and live blogs
• Read stories while listening to on-demand and live audio and video
• Breaking news push notifications
• Save download time and data costs by using the “Low-Bandwidth Mode”
• Bookmark and download for offline reading, watching, and listening
• Share your favorite stories via e-mail, Twitter, Facebook and other platforms
• Send your photo, video, audio and text reports to RFE/RL
